mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO), reduced manufacturing output lowers corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by >0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), increased borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.
